race.comment: SOME CHANCE (13) ran some good races last season in her first prep, and she has improved in each if her 3 tune up jump-outs leading into this modest maiden. She is down in class, and despite a wide gate, she has a sound each-way chance. BEAST FIGHTER (1) will find this far easier than any of his 2 starts back from a spell this season, and with the addition of winkers for the first time, he is set to figure in the top 3 for the first time. STORMING CAMELOT (4) was sound when fresh up in fourth place, and then had no luck off a wide gate here 15 days ago. He benefits from a 3kg claim this time, and is worth another chance. TALLINGAS PETEY (5) has an excuse fresh up from a long spell, and he can be a quick improver with that run under his belt. Include. CASMAR (16) has the pole position, and is worth each-way consideration.
